findings.title: Dependency manifest split between pyproject.toml and requirements.txt
findings.note: setup.py declares pyproject.toml the packaging source of truth, but CI still installs from requirements.txt rather than the package's own dependency list, leaving two places that state the requests version (>=2.31 vs ==2.32.3) with no stated plan to consolidate.

open_questions.question: README states the old src/pay/exporter.py job was removed in 0.1.0, but a differently-named legacy_export.py with export_v1 still exists — is this the same job under a new filename, or an unrelated leftover?
gateway.py migration_commits=1 corresponds to commit b2d3792 'migrate gateway to v2 API' — no v1 gateway code remains, so is there anything left to assess here or is this migration already complete?

looks_bad_but_fine.why: Four-line setuptools shim that explicitly documents pyproject.toml as the source of truth and duplicates only the package name; this is a stated, finished packaging decision, not active dual-path churn.
Single migration commit fully switched the module to the v2 API base URL; no v1 endpoint or dual-path code remains in the file.

not_assessed: Whether requests>=2.31 vs ==2.32.3 reflects an actual unpatched CVE or vulnerability
Whether export_v1 in legacy_export.py is still invoked by an external cron/scheduler outside this repository
Test coverage percentage relative to the fail_under=80 threshold in pyproject.toml
